title: Paper-1 v03r end-to-end organism canary v1d
summary: Preserve the narrow v03r canary while repairing every blocker accepted by the v1c adjudication: one executable semantic lock, seed-generic legal DEV projection, kind-disjoint row and query schemas, concrete cue-bound candidate rosters, one canonical ledger mapping, one sham validity route, one citation order, and an explicit narrow claim firewall. The cognitive mechanism is unchanged: proposals remain audit state until one fallible blind model self-check, and only model-supported proposals become immutable memory rows.
system_thesis: Before testing learned LOOP policy, rank pyramids, long lifetimes, or base promotion, determine whether one frozen and explicitly game-scaffolded resolver can convert dispersed public action outcomes into fallibly self-reviewed typed connections, use those connections under a later goal, and preserve immediate registered access through two isolated per-life LoRAs without an exact cognitive verifier or outcome-selected corpus.

nodes.before: Public v03r records had no canary-specific closed cognitive projection.
nodes.after: Before any heldout model dispatch, each public episode becomes one exact E audit object and predetermined witnessed-M projection; the probe, host-only goal, vocabulary, and public DIST control also seal, and only M enters cognition.
nodes.rationale: Bind experience and every outcome-relevant public transform without private-compatible fields or duplicated E/M evidence.

nodes.before: v1b treated a provisional proposal as a mutable memory row.
nodes.after: DREAM creates an immutable audit proposal; one blind model SELF_CHECK either creates one immutable SUPPORTED row or no cognitive row.
nodes.rationale: Preserve false self-approval while eliminating status mutation and semantic verification.

nodes.before: v1b recurrence pools, counters, seeds, and states were not machine-unique.
nodes.after: One exact 46-WAKE/22-REACTIVATE/16-SLEEP prefix and matched sixteen-slot OWN/DIST branches use closed states and branch-local deterministic selectors.
nodes.rationale: Test one-hop breadth/depth growth with reproducible treatment.

nodes.before: Text and LoRA returned incomparable or provenance-bearing objects.
nodes.after: THINK0/THINK1 operate for at most twelve opportunities and receive one closed H-handle semantic read projection independent of backend provenance.
nodes.rationale: Put traversal/composition in model tokens while preventing host text from carrying the path.

nodes.before: v1b goal timing was circular and DIST/path/sham could depend on forbidden or wrong data.
nodes.after: Public DIST seals pre-goal; role/causal candidates and unique matched sham seal after goal but before any T output; correctness is offline only.
nodes.rationale: Causally test realized memory content without selecting generation or repairs by result.

nodes.before: Candidate-to-row reconstruction and fit execution were selectable.
nodes.after: Exactly two pristine per-life rank-64 fits use four exact view families, every legal question index, one shared host-enumerated two-backend candidate roster, deterministic updates, two complete 48-case fidelity sets, and atomic mounts.
nodes.rationale: Test immediate candidate-constrained recognition only after useful text memory exists, without mislabeling it open recall.

nodes.before: v1b review objects and validity routing were prose-level and P1CB01 straddled implementation.
nodes.after: Ratification releases CPU only; exact packets, fresh reviewer and advocate dispositions, and closed authority tokens gate DEV, T, L, and terminal.
nodes.rationale: Prevent self-certification, changed-byte continuation, and unregistered GPU work.

nodes.before: v1c hash-bound mutually contradictory normative bytes without one total executable interpretation.
nodes.after: One exhaustive semantic-consistency matrix and one canonical opportunity-ledger schema bind every producer, consumer, ordering, validity class, and condition/state/reason mapping; unlisted, multiple, or contradictory semantics fail pre-dispatch.
nodes.rationale: Make implementation a transcription of ratified semantics rather than an outcome-relevant design choice.

loops.before: Dedicated dreams either restated episodes or jumped directly to solutions.
loops.after: Stateless local DREAM calls traverse witnessed/model-supported rows and propose at most one new typed connection; admission is a separate blind model call.
loops.trigger: Each registered WAKE, REACTIVATE, SLEEP, OWN, or DIST slot.
reads: at most five deterministic eligible neighbors
registered focus only in return branches
writes: zero or one immutable supported row after SELF_CHECK
loops.stop_condition: End after registered slots; malformed, illegal, duplicate, contradicted, or unresolved attempts consume their opportunities without retry.
loops.rationale: Approximate incremental BFS-like breadth and depth while retaining every loss.

loops.before: Goal return could leak final answers or depend on outcomes.
loops.after: Target-absent THINK0 requests one source-target frontier or defers; zero-call M0 and fixed OWN/DIST branches then evolve independently.
loops.trigger: Both target-absent M0 corpora and the non-answer public probe seal.
reads: one M0 H projection per query
writes: M1_OWN transport corpus regardless of score
loops.stop_condition: At most twelve THINK0 operations and sixteen return slots per nonzero branch; no retry.
loops.rationale: Test thinking-to-later-memory feedback without goal answer exposure.

loops.before: No closed sequential contract joined memory and a later action decision.
loops.after: Fresh THINK1 traces query one row, think/backtrack, and commit one public token under six prospective text readers and two conditional LoRA readers.
loops.trigger: Final goal and all applicable reader plans seal.
reads: public goal and pre-goal state vocabulary
loops.stop_condition: COMMIT, DEFER, invalid operation, infrastructure failure, or operation twelve; never operation thirteen.
loops.rationale: Measure DFS-like composition by the model rather than a graph solver.

loops.before: LoRA could be trained before one useful honest corpus existed.
loops.after: A reviewed T pass triggers exactly two fixed-corpus fits, both complete 48-case fidelity sets, their joint gate, atomic recognition reads, and clean-controller L traces.

loops.stop_condition: Absent infrastructure invalidity, both fits and all 96 fidelity cases complete before the joint gate; any later fidelity/isolation/runtime failure or completion ends without refit, tuning, stacking, or retry.
loops.rationale: Separate construction quality, candidate-constrained parametric recognition, and final composition.

loops.before: Stage review and authority admitted incompatible implementations.
loops.after: Each stage seals an exact inventory, receives two role-separated dispositions, and emits either one successor token or a terminal seal.
loops.trigger: CPU, DEV, T, L, or early failure seal.
loops.stop_condition: Any missing/changed artifact, overlap, rejection, invalidity, failure, or final result stops the graph.
loops.rationale: Keep the experiment prospective and auditable.

claims.before: No v03r recurrent organism had an exact prospective causal memory-use test.
claims.after: A green T supports only that this exact game-specific ontology- and proof-sequence-scaffolded system completed the target-absent THINK0-to-return-write feedback loop and structurally used offline-correct life-local content in later reasoning on one aligned seed-5 pair under registered readers. Public actions were environment-generated and the model committed only a final answer token, so this is not evidence of action improvement or online action learning.
claims.evidence_needed: Both exact non-NO_FOCUS THINK0 requests, paired T-OWN success, paired T-M0/T-DIST loss, an OWN-only correct focus row, donor-valid T-TWIN, T-PATH loss, T-SHAM retention, correct role/causal H handles cited in later ancestral reasoning and COMMIT, complete locks, accounting, and reviews.

claims.before: Goal-conditioned return could be credited from T-OWN success alone.
claims.after: Return credit requires the additional registered M0/DIST losses, nonempty OWN focus, OWN-only correct focus-matching row, actual returned-and-cited use, donor tokens, path loss, and sham retention.
claims.evidence_needed: All prospectively fixed branch/read artifacts and the complete extra conjunction.

claims.before: Candidate recognition was not safely mapped back to thinker-visible semantics.
claims.after: A green L supports only separate 44/48 immediate recognition on each selected 48-cue set and the registered own/donor decision paths for exactly two isolated per-life adapters. The host pre-resolves query cardinality and supplies one shared answer-bearing two-backend roster per concrete cue; this is not open recall, text equivalence, whole-corpus storage, durability, capacity, scale, RAG comparison, or superiority evidence.
claims.evidence_needed: Two pristine fixed-corpus fits, both complete 48-case sets, candidate-to-semantic mapping, roster disclosure, atomic mounts, structurally used relation handles, paired L-OWN, donor-valid L-TWIN, and reviews.

claims.before: Paper 1 seeks reliable improvement over strong memory baselines across increasing agent lifetimes.
claims.after: Unchanged. v1d cannot establish the Paper-1 headline, recurrence as a whole, generic construction, generalization, action improvement, online learning, continued improvement, open recall, whole-corpus storage, learned agency, rank scaling, saturation, durability, capacity, superiority, reviewer independence, autonomous discovery, or base promotion. A negative result also cannot localize failure beyond the registered stage and reason.
claims.evidence_needed: Later separately ratified replicated multi-world, multi-skin, strong-baseline, increasing-lifetime action studies.

acceptance_tests.setup: After ratification, validate every protocol/source/executable hash, scope, ceiling, stage dependency, review object, authority transition, schema resource, and every row of the exhaustive semantic-consistency matrix and canonical ledger mapping.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only CPU to reviewed 216-call DEV to reviewed 632-call T to conditional two-fit L to HUMAN_TERMINAL is reachable; seed-generic DEV through index 48 is legal; every contradictory or unlisted normative byte fails closed; P1CB01 never blocks CPU implementation itself.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The canary is one immutable finite staged experiment with one executable interpretation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Independently mutate every private/audit/prose/counter/result/donor/provenance field, each host-only final-goal coordinate, the rendered final question, and rosters swapped across concrete cue instances while public pre-reveal inputs remain fixed; separately mutate the registered focus treatment.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every pre-reveal rendered and tokenized request, selector, proposal, row, compiler view, concrete roster binding, corpus, training example, and read projection is byte-inert except registered descendants after authorized reveal; missing, swapped, wrong, or reused cue rosters are rejected; only allowlisted focus changes its branch.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: No answer-equivalent host-goal, audit, or roster side channel exists.

acceptance_tests.setup: Golden and adversarial-test every kind, event-to-row projection, proposal/check combination, duplicate ancestry, lineage, depth, conflict, cycle, and hash, including interleaved premise/support citation vectors and exactly-one-branch SOURCE_VALUE/ANIMAL_VALUE rows in DREAM and SELF_CHECK.
acceptance_tests.expected: Accepted citations always preserve emitted premises then supplied support-row order with first-occurrence dedup; valid witnessed row kinds validate exactly once; only witnessed or structurally model-supported immutable rows enter cognition, without semantic verifier, mutation, retry, or audit leakage.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Memory admission and provenance reduction are deterministic and honestly fallible.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise every legal one-null query/result branch in THINK0, THINK1, scratch, and previous_read; all H handles, state vocabulary, exact views, ambiguity and winner mappings; and one roster for every concrete semantic_hash/view_id/missing_index/cue instance with all named substitution negatives.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every legal query/result validates exactly one kind branch; each realized cue has exactly one exact cue-byte and token-hash-bound roster; missing, duplicate, swapped, wrong-semantic, wrong-view, or reused rosters fail; text and LoRA share only one provenance-free thinker projection and atomic mount discipline.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Registered candidate-constrained backend comparisons isolate mounted content without host path transfer.

acceptance_tests.setup: Match the complete 31-predictor vector and masks; seal NO_MEMORY, GOLD_TEXT, and GOLD_TWIN on six exact DEV lives; verify exact seed-0/1/2 public-projection and vocabulary hashes at actual counts through index 48 and unchanged seed-5 vectors.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every registered DEV life has one legal contiguous sole-projector output with no fixture-local mapper, truncation, alias gap, or heldout drift; shortcuts stay below threshold; both gold arms solve 3/3 with required G handles; NO_MEMORY is below 3/3; all 216 opportunities reconcile.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The heldout protocol has demonstrated nonshortcut downstream headroom on legally projected DEV fixtures.

acceptance_tests.setup: Use deterministic fake providers across the common exact 46/22/16 prefix, proposal admission, THINK0, M0 zero return, and matched sixteen-slot OWN/DIST return branches, including seeds, selectors, op-12, and non-dispatch cases.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every state, seed, counter, owner, row, handle, and ledger record matches; M1_OWN is fixed without results. Evidence is limited to executability and the goal-routed return intervention after a shared recurrent prefix.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The registered return-loop treatment is uniquely executable; it does not test necessity of prefix recurrence or repeated dreaming as a whole.

acceptance_tests.setup: On seed-5 twins, seal public projections, goal, vocabulary, DIST, candidates, path/sham, and all T plans in registered order; run every prospectively runnable trace and score only after seals.
acceptance_tests.expected: Missing roots is a valid mechanism negative. Sham infeasibility is only VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: the other five arms run, T-SHAM emits exact zero-attempt rows, and no full or weakened causal-use claim passes. Otherwise the complete pre-registered feedback, own/donor, path, sham, structural-use, accounting, and review conjunction is required.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: This exact prompted system can complete the registered feedback organism and causally use life-bound text content on the canary.

acceptance_tests.setup: Conditional on reviewed T pass, run exactly two pristine fixed-corpus fits, complete each selected 48-case cue set under one prospectively cue-bound shared answer roster, then atomic own/donor mounts and L-OWN/L-TWIN traces.
acceptance_tests.expected: Each adapter independently reaches 44/48; registered own/donor paths, isolation, accounting, and structural use pass. Evidence is disclosed as immediate host-pre-resolved candidate-constrained recognition only, never open recall, text equivalence, whole-corpus preservation, durability, capacity, scale, RAG comparison, or superiority.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Useful fixed corpora remain immediately candidate-recognizable through exactly two isolated per-life adapters on registered selected cues.

acceptance_tests.setup: Validate one canonical ledger schema and exhaustive unique condition/state/reason vectors for duplicate, precondition, unauthorized stage, COMMIT, REQUEST_RETURN, DEFER, budget exhaustion, model failure, infrastructure invalidity, missing abstraction, sham infeasibility, fidelity failure, and trace-local post-terminal opportunities.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every opportunity has exactly one mapped effect; stage failures use NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE, trace-local terminals use NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL, and every normative consumer is byte-identical. Unmapped, multiply mapped, cross-contract-different, retried, fake, or partial rows fail.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Reported outcomes correspond to one total runtime and compute accounting envelope.

acceptance_tests.setup: At every transition and terminal, present identical immutable packets to a fresh reviewer and separate advocate; validate platform-attested identities, exact inventories, no mutation, verdict supremacy, and positive and negative claim-linter fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Any rejection or changed byte stops; every result reaches HUMAN_TERMINAL. The linter rejects recurrence-as-a-whole, generic construction, generalization, action improvement, online or continued learning, open recall, whole-corpus storage, durability, capacity, scale, superiority, text/LoRA equivalence, proved reviewer independence, Paper-1-headline language, and negative-result overlocalization.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The experiment cannot self-certify, drift, or promote one scaffolded pair beyond its evidence.

human_boundary.decision_question: After two new fresh-context interpretations, adversarial cross-critique, and a releasable consensus, does Rohin ratify the exact v1d protocol-lock and scope for CPU implementation; reviewed 216-operation DEV_GOLD; reviewed 632-operation HELDOUT_TEXT; and, only after a reviewed text pass, exactly two isolated rank-64 per-life M1_OWN MEMORY-LoRA fits plus 96 fidelity cases and at most 48 LoRA-backed THINK1 operations, with every result ending at HUMAN_TERMINAL?
